title: nan
authors: Trujillo J.-C.; Munguia R.; Urzua S.; Guerra E.; Grau A.
key_contribution: Presents a monocular visual SLAM system with observability analysis and Lyapunov control for cooperative UAV tracking of moving targets in GPS-denied environments.

methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Visual_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
